text:
Highland Elementary School tested only 5th graders in science MCA for 2024-25
Only fifth-grade students at Highland Elementary School completed the science portion of the 2024-25 MCA, the Minnesota Department of Education reported.
In total, all 69 participating students in the science exam from Highland were members of the fifth-grade class.
Based on test criteria, 22% of those fifth graders achieved proficiency in science.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state assessments that evaluate student achievement toward Minnesota’s academic standards in line with federal and state laws. The subjects assessed include math, reading, and science, with the areas tested varying by grade level. While most students take the MCA, those receiving special education services and qualifying for certain criteria may participate in the Alt MCA.
Data from Minnesota’s Report Card shows that proficiency rates on the state’s MCA exams have dropped since before the pandemic. Math proficiency rates declined by more than 7% since 2019, while reading proficiency decreased by nearly 5%.
Details for this article come from the Minnesota Department of Education, with the original source data available here.
